newsitem.title: FINLAND: M-Serla sees better earnings prospect 97.
newsitem.headline: M-Serla sees better earnings prospect 97.

text.p: Finnish forest industry group Metsa-Serla Oy president and CEO Jorma Vaajoki said on Thursday he expected the prospects for 1997 earnings to be slightly better than this year.
"It looks like next year's earnings level and the possibilities to achieve earnings would be slightly better than this year," Vaajoki told reporters after a news conference.
Metsa-Serla earlier reported a sharp fall in January-August profits, and said it expected to post a loss in the final tertial, but the full-year 1996 result would nevertheless show a profit.
Vaajoki said Metsa-Serla's 1996 result would be "clearly positive". He did not elaborate.
